proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.options[].fixedChargeCost
proposed_widenings.justification: The cure-poison mode always costs exactly 5 charges from the pool, regardless of player choice. The current surface has no way to express a fixed per-option charge cost within a CastTimeEffectModeChoice. Without it, the trace shows remove_condition as a freely choosable mode branch with no cost constraint, which is misleading — the RAW cost is 5, not variable.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.

notes: The primary healing mechanic (charge_pool with linear_per_level cap, heal_hp with resource_spent) fits the surface exactly — types.ts even names Lay on Hands as the canonical pressure case for DiceAmount.resource_spent. The cure-poison secondary mode encodes structurally (remove_condition atom exists, CastTimeEffectModeChoice works in a direct phase) but lacks a fixedChargeCost field on the mode option. That missing field is the sole widening. Outcome is surface_widening, not clean.
